title: Abstention is not defect-free certification
failure_mode: Empty report confused with quality certification

source.quote:
| W3-01, reviews.py | The separate reviewer removed both findings and both remedies. The selected quotations did not show all filtering logic claimed, and the proposed fixes assumed a multi-process deployment that was not established. The empty report asks for deployment details. This demonstrates filtering and abstention; it does not establish that the module has no defects. The reviewer may be overly conservative about standard threading.Lock semantics when no authoritative reference is selected. |
| W3-02, freshness.py | The retained statements match the inspected checks: positive non-boolean integer age, timezone-aware current time, invalid naive/future snapshots counted as missing, and stale age at or above the threshold. A snapshot equal to now is accepted. Proposed boundary tests are not claimed as run by the agent. Findings are sorted medium before low; AI verdict indices refer to the original draft order. |
| W3-03, hosted_embeddings.py | Both draft findings were removed because the selected excerpts did not establish every HTTP/response validation or cache-invalidation claim. The remaining proposal is to document the observed fingerprint composition. No missing-key, error-leak, cache-defect, or successful runtime behavior is established by this handoff. |

context.question: Statically review the selected evidence. Separate supported observations from unverified outcomes and propose focused checks.

findings.statement: The selected inspection records removal of both W3-01 findings and explicitly says the empty report does not establish the module has no defects.
findings.rationale: This is an attributed description of the visible engineering note, not independent validation.

findings.statement: W3-01 was independently certified defect-free because its final findings list was empty.
findings.rationale: The selected note explicitly rejects that conclusion and says deployment details were missing.

next_steps.proposal: Request deployment details before applying a remedy that assumes multiple processes.
next_steps.rationale: The note identifies that missing prerequisite for the rejected remedies.

finding_verdicts.reason: Quote confirms removal of both findings and states empty report does not prove no defects.
Quote explicitly says it does NOT establish defect‑free status, contradicting claim.

next_step_verdicts.reason: Quote notes deployment details were not established and requests them, matching proposal.
